This Privacy Policy explains how [homeflip_business field="name"] ("we," "us") collects and uses the information you give us on this website.

What we collect

When you fill out a form on this site, we collect the information you enter, such as your name, email address, phone number, property address, and details about the property or what you want to buy. We also record the page you submitted the form from.

How we use it

We use your information to respond to you, to make you an offer on your property, to send you properties that match what you told us you want to buy, and to keep you updated about our services. If you opted in, we may contact you by text message and email.

Text messages

If you check the opt-in box, you agree to receive text messages from [homeflip_business field="name"]. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP at any time to stop receiving texts, or HELP for help. Opting in is never a condition of doing business with us.

We will not share or sell your mobile phone number or text messaging consent with third parties or affiliates for marketing purposes.

Sharing

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers who help us run our business (for example, the software we use to store contacts and send messages), and when required by law.

Your choices

You can ask us to update or delete your information, or unsubscribe from emails at any time using the link in any email.

Contact us

[homeflip_contact address="yes"]
